main.description: A device that holds the drive's keys, or asks for them, keyed by the device's ID (a TID). Not sealed: a device asks before it has the keys, and the others read its public key to wrap the keyring for it. One more record, key 'recovery', holds only recoveryKeyring.

name.description: The device's name, shown in device lists and pairing prompts.

publicKey.description: The device's raw X25519 public key.

keyring.description: The drive's keyring, wrapped for this device. Absent while it waits to be approved.

approvedBy.description: The ID of the device that approved this one, if it wasn't itself.

recoveryKeyring.description: Only in the record with key 'recovery': the keyring wrapped with the recovery key.
